tasks.title: JSON Schemas for the model, issues and theme files
tasks.description:
Write the three JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) that define archmap's file contracts, following docs/design.md section 5 exactly.

- schema/archmap-model.schema.json: meta (schemaVersion, project, commit, generatedAt, repoUrl, profile, sources, coverage),
  zones, nodes, edges, entities (fields with provenance declared|observed|inferred), relations (cardinality 1-1|1-n|n-m,
  kind fk|join|name-convention), access (ops is a non-empty subset of "CRUD"), sequences (step grammar: message {m,k,t,d,r,ret?,i?},
  fragment {frag: alt|else|opt|loop|end, t}, note {note, t, tone}), views. Edge type enum: api, static, auth, pull, sql, cache,
  persist, call, link, deploy, event, queue. Edge confidence: verified|inferred|external. Optional edge "foundBy":
  static|llm|introspection (design section 14.3). Evidence item: {path, lines} where lines is "N" or "N-M".
- schema/archmap-issues.schema.json: {id, sev high|med|low, category security|data|reliability|performance|design|docs, title,
  anchor (exactly one of node|edge|entity|step), summary, impact, fix, detail?, evidence, source archmap|audit, track?}.
- schema/archmap-theme.schema.json: fonts, chrome and accent only. Relation, zone and severity colours are fixed (D10) and must
  NOT be themeable.

Rules: readers tolerate unknown keys, so do not set additionalProperties:false on objects (compatibility, design section 5).
Evidence is required (minItems 1) on nodes and edges. Keep to a small keyword subset that validate.mjs (next task) will
interpret without npm deps: type, required, properties, items, enum, const, pattern, minItems, minLength, oneOf, $ref to
local $defs. No format, no if/then, no remote $ref.
Referential checks (dangling ids) are NOT expressible here; they belong to validate.mjs.

I then wrote schema/archmap-model.schema.json, archmap-issues.schema.json and archmap-theme.schema.json (draft 2020-12, each with an $id). The only keywords they use are type, required, properties, items, enum, const, pattern, minItems, minLength, oneOf and local $defs refs. None sets additionalProperties. Evidence has minItems 1 on nodes, edges and issues, and lines matches ^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?$. access.ops matches ^(?!.*(.).*\1)[CRUD]+$, a non-empty subset with no repeats. Steps are a oneOf of message, fragment and note. An issue anchor is a oneOf of four single-key shapes. The theme declares only fonts, chrome and accent. Decisions the design left open: the model requires meta, zones, nodes and edges, and the other arrays are optional. The issues file root is {schemaVersion?, issues:[...]}, with the issue shape in $defs.issue. Theme accent is a #rrggbb string. I used the interpreter in the test only to check the schemas; it is not a dependency. The `writing-javascript` skill the brief lists does not exist (Unknown skill), so only test-driven-development was invoked. tasks.title: validate.mjs: schema subset, referential integrity and evidence checks
tasks.description:
Implement scripts/validate.mjs (Node >= 18, ESM, zero npm deps) and a tiny JSON Schema subset interpreter in
scripts/lib/jsonschema.mjs that supports exactly the keywords P1.1's schemas use (type, required, properties, items, enum,
const, pattern, minItems, minLength, oneOf, local $ref). Unknown keys in data are allowed.

CLI: node scripts/validate.mjs <model.json> [--issues <issues.json>] [--repo <dir>] [--json]
Checks, each finding with a JSON pointer and a stable code:
1. Schema: the model against schema/archmap-model.schema.json, the issues file against archmap-issues.schema.json.
2. Referential integrity: node.zone, zone.parent, edge.from/to, entity.store (a node id), field.fk and relations
   entity/field pairs, access.node/entity, sequence participant node and step m[] ids, note ids, view filters,
   issue anchors (node|edge|entity|"<seqId>:<stepIndex>"), step i (issue id, only when --issues is given). Duplicate ids.
3. Evidence (design section 14.3, borrowed from show-me): with --repo, for each evidence {path, lines} run
   `git -C <repo> cat-file -e <meta.commit>:<path>` and check the line range is within the file at that commit
   (git show). Without --repo the check is skipped and the output says so - it is never a silent pass.
Export a validate(model, {issues, repo}) function returning {ok, findings[]} so later scripts (merge, render) reuse it.
Output: human-readable by default, --json for machines. Exit 0 valid, 1 findings, 2 usage or unreadable input.
Use small inline fixtures and a throwaway git repo created in os.tmpdir() in the tests; do not depend on P1.3's golden model.

tasks.description:
Hand-write the golden fixture: an archmap model of the reference app, a FastAPI + React + DuckDB dashboard that pulls
from an upstream data platform. Derive it from the single HTML file in .private/reference/, which you may READ but
must never copy, quote or name in any tracked file - not even its filename. THIS REPO IS PUBLIC.

Anonymisation rules (all mandatory):
- Use a fictional project name ("Northwind Insights"), fictional org, and generic repo paths (backend/app/..., frontend/src/...).
  Keep the architecture's shape: zones, the node set, the typed edges, the entities and fields, the 7 sequences and the step grammar.
- The upstream data platform, the SSO proxy, the lab-notebook vendor and any client product, site or table names become
  generic names ("Upstream data platform", "Corporate SSO proxy", "External lab notebook"). No client names, people,
